name: activate_window
description: Focus a Linux desktop window by window_id, pid, app_id, wm_class, title, or terminal selectors when the compositor permits it.

name: click
description: Click an element by index, semantic selector, or desktop coordinate pixels from screenshot metadata. Plain left activation prefers a native AT-SPI click/press/toggle action, avoiding toolkit coordinate scaling. Entry activate and slider jump actions are not substituted for pointer clicks. Explicit coordinates, right clicks, and multi-clicks retain pointer semantics.

relative.description:
Interpret `x`/`y` from the clipped window screenshot crop origin, in
coordinate pixels before preview resizing. Divide preview pixels by its
scale first. This is not a toolkit widget or raw GDK surface origin.
Requires a window target; missing targets are rejected.

name: doctor
description: Report Linux Computer Use desktop integration readiness.

capabilities.description:
Which interchangeable backends this environment supports, per layer, plus
the one the tool prefers. Lets an agent (or selector) understand what's
available and choose accordingly instead of assuming one fixed path.

isolation.description: Display/session isolation contexts the host can provide.

preferred.description: The backend the tool will use by default for each selectable layer.

wtype.description: Wayland virtual-keyboard backend for layout-safe Unicode literal text.

xdotool.description:
X11 XTEST keyboard backend. Preferred over ydotool on X11 sessions,
where raw evdev scancodes are re-mapped by the active XKB layout.

x11_display.description:
Native X11 display for the root-window screenshot route. Fails on
Wayland sessions, including XWayland, by design.

can_capture_screenshots.description:
A raw screenshot was successfully captured while producing this report.
Doctor only detects routes, so this remains false until capture is tested.

warnings.description: Untested capabilities and optional remediation, without blocking setup.

oneOf.description: No backend route was detected; no capture was attempted.
At least one route was detected; no capture was attempted.
A raw screenshot was captured successfully for this report.
The raw capture attempted for this report failed.

name: drag
description: Drag from one point to another using pixel coordinates.

name: focused_window
description: Return the compositor window that currently has keyboard focus.

name: get_app_state
description: Start an app use session if needed, then get a size-bounded screenshot and accessibility state for a Linux app. Scope the accessibility tree with app_name_or_bundle_identifier or a window_id/pid/app_id/wm_class/title target; omitting a target returns the whole desktop tree and can flood context. Screenshot results include coordinate_width, coordinate_height, scale, format, and quality when the returned image is downscaled or compressed; callers can request jpeg/quality for compression before resizing.

app_id.description:
Application id. Also scopes the accessibility tree when it matches an
AT-SPI root.

app_name_or_bundle_identifier.description:
App name or AT-SPI id that limits the accessibility tree. Omit only when
you need the whole desktop tree; unscoped results can flood context.

format.description: Output image format (default png). Use jpeg with quality to trade exact pixels for smaller payloads.

include_screenshot.description:
Include a size-bounded screenshot (default true). Set false when the
accessibility tree is enough.

max_bytes.description: Maximum returned screenshot image bytes before base64 (default 2 MiB, hard-capped).

max_depth.description: Maximum AT-SPI traversal depth (default 32, hard max 64).

max_height.description: Maximum returned screenshot height in pixels (default 1920, hard-capped).

max_nodes.description: Maximum raw AT-SPI nodes to inspect before compaction (default 1000, hard max 2000).

max_width.description: Maximum returned screenshot width in pixels (default 1920, hard-capped).

pid.description:
Process id. Also scopes the accessibility tree to that process when it
exposes AT-SPI.

quality.description: JPEG quality from 1 to 95 (default 80). Ignored for png.

scale.description: Additional downscale factor from 0.0 to 1.0, applied before max dimensions.

terminal_command.description:
Terminal command substring. Resolves a window target and scopes the tree
when possible.

terminal_cwd.description:
Terminal working directory. Resolves a window target and scopes the tree
when possible.

terminal_pid.description:
Terminal emulator pid. Resolves a window target and scopes the tree when
possible.

title.description:
Window title substring. Also scopes the accessibility tree when it
matches an AT-SPI root.

tty.description:
Terminal tty device (for example /dev/pts/3). Resolves a window target
and scopes the tree when possible.

verbose.description:
Include the full diagnostics report (large). Default false: only the
compact readiness block is returned.

window_id.description:
Compositor window id. Also scopes the accessibility tree to that window's
application when possible.

wm_class.description:
Window manager class. Also scopes the accessibility tree when it matches
an AT-SPI root.

accessibility_tree_truncated.description:
True when max_nodes, max_depth, or the child read budget stopped
traversal with unread elements left, so the tree is incomplete. Recover
by scoping to a narrower app or window target and raising max_nodes or
max_depth (hard caps 2000 and 64). Failed element reads do not count.

diagnostics.description: Full diagnostics; populated only when verbose=true.

screenshot.description: Screenshot metadata; the image itself is the first `image` content block.

tree_scoped.description:
True when the snapshot was limited to selected app roots rather than the
full desktop AT-SPI registry.

Screenshot metadata for `get_app_state`. The image bytes travel as a

name: list_apps
description: List running Linux desktop app candidates visible to the Computer Use backend.

name: list_windows
description: List compositor windows with title, app id, class, focus state, client type, and known bounds.

name: perform_action
description: Invoke an accessibility action exposed by an element selected by index, identifier, or semantic selector. Defaults to the primary action unless action is provided.

name: press_key
description: Press a key or key-combination on the keyboard, optionally after focusing a target window or terminal selector. Key grammar (case-insensitive; hyphens/spaces ignored): combos join with '+', e.g. Ctrl+L or Ctrl+Shift+T. Modifiers: ctrl/control, alt/option, shift, meta/super/cmd/command. Named keys: enter/return, escape/esc, tab, backspace, delete/del, space, home, end, pageup, pagedown, arrowleft/left, arrowright/right, arrowup/up, arrowdown/down, f1-f12. Plus single US letters a-z and digits 0-9. Anything else returns an error (never silently dropped). On Wayland, chords are sent through an active remote desktop portal keyboard session when one is available (or when ydotool is absent), falling back to ydotool otherwise. Portal chords send modifiers and named keys as keysyms so remapped keys (e.g. Caps Lock swapped with Control) follow the active keymap; letters and digits are physical US positions. Note: compositor-level shortcuts (e.g. Super+Up) may be consumed by GNOME before reaching the app.

name: screenshot
description: Capture the screen and return it as a viewable, size-bounded image. Optionally target a window (window_id/pid/wm_class/title/app_id): the window is raised to the front and the image is cropped before any resize. Returns the image plus a short caption with returned dimensions, coordinate dimensions, scale, format, quality, source, and crop bounds; callers can request jpeg/quality for compression before resizing.

format.description: Output image format (default png). Use jpeg with quality to trade exact pixels for smaller payloads.

full_screen.description: Capture the whole desktop even when a window is targeted (default false).

max_bytes.description: Maximum returned screenshot image bytes before base64 (default 2 MiB, hard-capped).

max_height.description: Maximum returned screenshot height in pixels (default 1920, hard-capped).

max_width.description: Maximum returned screenshot width in pixels (default 1920, hard-capped).

quality.description: JPEG quality from 1 to 95 (default 80). Ignored for png.

raise_window.description:
Raise the targeted window before capture (default true). Ignored without
a window target.

scale.description: Additional downscale factor from 0.0 to 1.0, applied before max dimensions.

name: scroll
description: Scroll an element in a direction by a number of pages. With a window target and no x/y/element_index, scrolls at the centre of the targeted window.

relative.description:
Interpret `x`/`y` from the clipped window screenshot crop origin, in
coordinate pixels before preview resizing. Divide preview pixels by its
scale first. This is not a toolkit widget or raw GDK surface origin.
Requires a window target; missing targets are rejected.

name: set_value
description: Set the value of a settable accessibility element selected by index, identifier, or semantic selector.

name: type_text
description: Type literal text using keyboard input, optionally after focusing a target window or terminal selector.
